rows.label: tlk44600184_04_msg0001
rows.name:
You're from outside, right? More of
you have been coming lately. Are you
shopping at the black market too?

rows.label: tlk44600184_04_msg0002
rows.name:
This shop opens only at night
and sells things you won't find
through official channels.

rows.label: tlk44600184_04_msg0003
rows.name:
The quality used to be low, but it's
improved since outsiders started
coming. It really helps.
